regime_context: The TSX sector landscape shows a broad rotation, led by Base Metals & Copper (XBM.TO) with strong momentum, full breadth, moderate durability, and no crowding. Gold Miners (XGD.TO) are the closest challenger, also in a durable uptrend. Low-ranked groups like Technology (XIT.TO) are negative, with Technology being crowded but still trending. The validated absolute-trend gate supports staying with trends, while momentum rank has no alpha.
emerging_watch: Gold Miners (XGD.TO) is the closest challenger to Base Metals, with a score of 1.28 and strong trend (hurts_tag=trend, durability 0.79). If Gold Miners’ momentum score overtakes Base Metals’ score by a margin of 0.1 or more on a closing basis within the next 10 trading days, it would signal a confirmed leadership handoff worthy of a re-evaluation.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Base Metals & Copper is the dominant theme with top momentum rank, full breadth, eligibility under the absolute-trend gate, and no crowding. Despite momentum not predicting returns, the trend gate helps avoid shake-outs, and the theme's breadth and durability suggest it is likely to persist in the near term, so an overweight lean is justified.
theses.dissent: Momentum rank has no forward return edge; base metals can be driven by idiosyncratic commodity moves that reverse, and the durability is only moderate; a sudden risk-off or copper price drop could hurt.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO underperforms the S&P/TSX Composite by 5% over the next 20 trading days before 2026-09-04.

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Technology is ranked 15th, with deeply negative momentum and a crowded label. While still trending, the combination of low rank and crowding suggests elevated risk of poor relative performance, and the trend gate does not exempt from relative weakness. An avoid lean reduces exposure to a potentially vulnerable area.
theses.dissent: Crowded trends can persist; Technology has high durability and a trending tag, which could indicate ongoing outperformance. Crowding alone is not a sell signal, and negative momentum may reverse.

falsifier.text: XIT.TO outperforms the S&P/TSX Composite by 5% over the next 20 trading days before 2026-09-04.
